body.name: Action-constrained clipped score cost
body.construction: For \(\pi\in\mathcal F\), \(x\in\mathcal X\), and \(c\in\mathcal C\), define \(d_{\pi xc}=1\) if \(c(x)\neq\pi(x)\), \(d_{\pi xc}=0\) if \(c(x)=\pi(x)=a_0\), and \(d_{\pi xc}=\min\{1,\Gamma|m_{\pi}-m_c|\}\) otherwise; then set \(r_{\pi x}(S)=\min(\{1\}\cup\{d_{\pi xc}:c\in S\})\) and \(R_{\pi}(S)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}q_xr_{\pi x}(S)\).
